integrity: New statements are supported by explicit calculations and a replayable standalone finite-field checker; the general theorem is proved analytically, not extrapolated from tests. The general ZPD criterion is credited to its earlier authors.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicitly presented seven-dimensional two-step algebra and its quotient commuting two-planes; not general H-type algebras, universal classification or full commuting-pair scheme structure. Historical priority and independent proof audit remain open.
title: A conic criterion for zero-product determination in a seven-dimensional two-step Lie algebra
